scope: Local publication checks, not new research or automatic external code review

privacy_scan.scope: New v10-v13 public text only; shorter excerpts and paraphrases are outside this detector's guarantee

limitations: Historical failed versions and their results are preserved, not reported as current passing code
No full natural-source re-adjudication or human validation
Package hashes validate public derivative bytes, not original historical freeze identity
CI and automatic review status must be read from the pull request for its exact commit
